entities.name: Maria Eugênia Villarta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Eugênia Simi Villarta Cardoso, best known as Maria Eugênia Villarta, is a Brazilian businesswoman, plastic artist and former fashion model. She was the model who has made the most magazine covers in Brazil to date, has had her face on approximately 300 of them, in addition to being exclusive to the brand Marcelo Beauty and L'Oréal for many years.
